g=[[1]*22 for _ in range(18)]
# draw extrapolated straight diagonal lines for paired colors
for color, pts in [(9,[(8,3),(9,4)]),(6,[(8,6),(9,5)]),(7,[(10,4),(11,3)])]:

  rr=r+t*dr; cc=c+t*dc
